adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /v2/auth/whoami with empty operation input. Native recipe returns the raw HTTP JSON body rather than the upstream parser's whoami reshape.

Caller supplies bounded cursor and limit. Repeated ids, fieldIds, and fieldTypes query arrays are omitted because native query objects cannot emit exploded repeated keys. Pagination nextUrl/prevUrl are returned as data and never followed.

Numeric personId is encoded in the fixed /v2/persons/{personId} path. Optional fieldIds/fieldTypes selectors are omitted because native query objects cannot emit exploded repeated keys. Native recipe returns the raw Person JSON rather than wrapping it as {person}.
